task_type_fields.evidence:
Repo: bob-plugins (linked). Test: scripts/test-ledger-tools-relation-chips.cjs, "MN click opens the source at its occurrence line and column, with Mod-click using a new pane" (assertion near line 1131, cursor/focus call order).

Observations:
- bob-cli-ln.5 note #5 (2026-11-15): full `npm test` on unchanged bob-plugins 6615a3f failed relation-chips:1131 (MN-click cursor/focus timing) alongside the tracked 25 ms budget flakes; baseline collected before any edits in that phase.
- bob-cli-kb.2 note #1 (2026-11-11): "a transient Relation Chips click assertion failure that passed on clean HEAD" during a full run.
